Players Committee card image of [[Zam Wesell (ALT) (Errata)|Zam Wesell (ALT) (Errata 2)]] (errata PC-E2), game text: “Adds 2 to power of anything she pilots. If alone, draws one battle destiny if unable to otherwise. If opponent's leader just lost from same site, opponent loses 2 Force. If just lost, may search your Force Pile and take any one card into hand; reshuffle.”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Dark/large/zamwesell_ai.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/6cae8c9ca0ffa879985fee5c01eca246364add0d 6cae8c9] (20 January 2026). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is the latest version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged (the repository file is named .gif but is PNG data, so it is uploaded with a .png name).
